_doc: P6 M1 tier declarations for the demo deployment. vr = the investigation corpus (chunk-indexed, receipts). plans/channels are REGISTERED (resolvable, authority-tagged) but not chunk-indexed until their parsers land (P6 M2+). derived = engine outputs; never a source (generalized self-consumption guard). wiki/corpus-orienteer (the OpenWiki OKF pages) is derived: emitted by adapters/openwiki/emit_okf.py, never re-ingested.
